[MEASURED] physics/track_gen.py, 8 lobes / 0.20 amplitude / 3 harmonics — parameters chosen by sweep. Mean 72.8% cornering time vs 40.7% across the 24 real TUM circuits: 1.79x the learning signal per training step.
